TITRE : Analyste en assurance qualité linguistique (LQA) espagnol latino-américain

LIEU : Montréal

SERVICE : Localisation mondiale

ENTREPRISE : 2K (Take-Two Interactive)

TYPE : Temps plein

Fondée en 2005, 2K Games est une entreprise internationale de jeux vidéo, éditant des titres développés par certains des studios de développement les plus influents au monde. Nos studios, responsables du développement du portefeuille de jeux de classe mondiale de 2K sur plusieurs plateformes, incluent Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber et HB Studios. Notre portefeuille de titres s’élargit grâce à notre plan stratégique mondial ainsi qu’à la création et à l’acquisition de studios novateurs dont les contenus continuent d’inspirer des millions de joueur·euse·s à travers le monde ! 2K publie des titres dans les genres de jeu les plus populaires : jeux de sport, jeux de tir, de rôle, d’action, de stratégie, ainsi que des jeux occasionnels et familiaux.

Notre équipe d’ingénieur·e·s, de spécialistes du marketing, d’artistes, de scénaristes, de scientifiques de données, de producteur·rice·s, de penseur·euse·s et de personnes d’action constitue le pilier éditorial professionnel de notre bibliothèque croissante de franchises acclamées par la critique telles que NBA 2K, BioShock, Borderlands, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, Tiny Tina’s Wonderlands, WWE 2K et XCOM.

Chez 2K, nous sommes fier·ère·s de créer un environnement de travail inclusif, ce qui signifie encourager les membres de nos équipes à venir tel·le·s qu’ils·elles sont et à se dépasser ! Nous encourageons la diversité et l’inclusion et voulons que notre communauté de candidat·e·s reflète cet engagement. Nous encourageons toutes les personnes qualifiées à explorer nos opportunités à l’échelle internationale. 2K a son siège social à Novato, en Californie, et est un label détenu en propriété exclusive par Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ : TTWO).

Vous aimez les jeux vidéo? Vous aimez les langues? Dans le cadre de l'initiative Global Loc 2.0 de 2K, nous mettons en place une approche de la localisation plus intégrée et davantage centrée sur la qualité, et les analystes LQA en sont au cœur. En tant qu'analyste LQA I, vous serez parmi les premières personnes à découvrir nos jeux dans votre langue maternelle et à contribuer à la façon dont ils résonnent auprès des joueurs du monde entier.

Il s'agit d'un poste de premier échelon, idéal pour des professionnel·le·s rigoureux·ses et doté·e·s d'une grande sensibilité linguistique qui souhaitent faire leurs premiers pas dans le jeu vidéo ou la localisation. Vous testerez des contenus en prélancement afin d'en vérifier l'exactitude linguistique, la pertinence culturelle et le bon fonctionnement de l'interface, tout en vous familiarisant avec les outils, les systèmes et les modes de collaboration qui donnent vie aux expériences mondiales de 2K.

Ce que vous ferez

• Réaliser des passes de test sur les versions localisées afin de vérifier l'exactitude linguistique, fonctionnelle et visuelle.
• Identifier et consigner les bogues de localisation, des problèmes de traduction aux défauts d'interface, en fournissant des étapes détaillées et reproductibles.
• Veiller à la cohérence de l'orthographe, de la grammaire, de la terminologie, du ton, de l'utilisation des variables et de la pertinence culturelle
• Corriger ou proposer des modifications et des traductions pour les problèmes linguistiques objectifs, directement dans les systèmes de gestion de texte.
• Analyser les problèmes signalés afin d'en déterminer les causes potentielles et de repérer les tendances révélatrices de risques systémiques de localisation ou d'internationalisation (i18n).
• Signaler les risques de localisation tôt dans le cycle de développement, y compris les problèmes potentiels liés aux variables, aux contraintes d'interface ou à la clarté du texte source.
• Contribuer à la validation des glossaires et des guides de style dans le cadre des cycles de révision qualité plus larges.
• Suivre les plans de test documentés et contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration des cas de test.
• Évaluer la qualité de la localisation au regard des normes des éditeurs propriétaires, de la terminologie des détenteurs de plateformes et des exigences de marque.
• Examiner les tickets de localisation et les signalements de joueurs, en aidant à reproduire et à faire remonter les problèmes confirmés.
• Participer aux réunions quotidiennes de l'équipe LQA, au tri des bogues et aux revues qualité de jalon.
• Se tenir à jour sur la terminologie clé des projets et servir de référence pour votre langue maternelle.

Ce dont nous avons besoin

• Maîtrise parfaite de l'espagnol latino-américain, la langue prise en charge pour ce poste.
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais.
• 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité (AQ fonctionnelle, AQ de localisation ou fonctions de test connexes), avec une maîtrise linguistique démontrée de la langue prise en charge.
• Expérience des consoles de jeu, des plateformes mobiles ou de la terminologie du développement de jeux.
• Connaissance des normes de certification des détenteurs de plateformes (Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft).
• Connaissance des flux de travail d'AQ et de localisation, notamment la consignation des bogues et l'exécution des tests.
• Connaissance de JIRA, des plateformes de suivi de bogues ou des systèmes de gestion de texte.
• Aisance avec Microsoft Office, Google Workspace et les plateformes de gestion de versions.
• Proactivité, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit collaboratif.
• Capacité à travailler dans le respect des délais, à suivre les consignes et à poser des questions au besoin.
• Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle ou expérience équivalente requis.
• Passion pour les jeux vidéo et la narration interculturelle.

Ce qui fera de vous un bon candidat

• Première expérience des outils de localisation ou de TAO (par exemple : Trados, MemoQ, XLOC).
• Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires d'AQ externes ou des réviseur·se·s indépendant·e·s, ou de supervision de ceux-ci.
• Certification ISTQB ou accréditation équivalente en AQ.
• Connaissance des normes régionales de classification par âge, en particulier sur les territoires pris en charge.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE?

En tant qu'analyste LQA I, vous entamerez votre parcours au cœur des efforts de localisation de 2K, en contribuant à rendre nos jeux clairs, culturellement pertinents et agréables pour les joueurs du monde entier. Vous développerez des compétences fondamentales en assurance qualité linguistique dans un environnement collaboratif et multilingue, tout en acquérant une expérience pratique des outils, des processus et des flux de travail qui soutiennent le développement de jeux à l'échelle mondiale.

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K, one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®, and XCOM®, as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K, TopSpin®, and PGA TOUR® 2K. We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.

Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.

But what truly powers 2K is our people.

We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Love games? Love languages? As part of 2K’s Global Loc 2.0 initiative, we’re building a more embedded and quality-focused approach to localization—and LQA Analysts are at the heart of it. As an LQA Analyst I, you'll be among the first to experience our games in your native language and help shape how they resonate with players across the globe.

This is an entry-level role perfect for linguistically sharp, detail-oriented professionals looking to break into games or localization. You’ll test pre-release content for linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and UI functionality—while learning the tools, systems, and collaboration models that bring 2K’s global experiences to life.

What You’ll Do

• Execute test passes on localized builds to verify linguistic, functional, and visual accuracy
• Identify and log localization bugs—ranging from translation issues to UI problems—using detailed, reproducible steps
• Ensure consistency in spelling, grammar, terminology, tone, variable usage, and cultural appropriateness
• Amend or propose edits and translations to objective linguistic issues directly in text management systems
• Analyze reported issues to identify potential root causes and flag patterns that may indicate systemic localization or i18n risks.
• Flag localization risks early in the development cycle, including potential issues with variables, UI constraints, or source text clarity
• Support glossary and style guide validation as part of broader quality review cycles
• Follow documented test plans and contribute to test case creation and improvement
• Evaluate localization quality against first-party standards, platform-holder terminology, and branding requirements
• Review localization tickets or player reports, helping reproduce and escalate verified issues
• Participate in LQA team standups, bug triage, and milestone QA reviews
• Stay current on key project terminology and serve as a resource for your native language Spanish Latin American

What We Need

• Native level fluency in your supported language Spanish Latin American
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills
• 1–3 years of experience in QA (functional QA, localization QA, or related testing roles), with demonstrated linguistic proficiency in the supported language.
• Experience with game consoles, mobile platforms, or game development terminology
• Familiarity with first-party certification standards (Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft)
• Familiarity with QA and localization workflows, including bug logging and test execution
• Knowledge of JIRA, bug tracking platforms, or text management systems
• Comfortable with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and version control platforms
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and organized, with a collaborative mindset
• Ability to work under deadlines, follow instructions, and ask questions when needed
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
• Passion for video games and cross-cultural storytelling

What Will Make You A Great Fit

• Exposure to localization or CAT tools (e.g., Trados, MemoQ, XLOC)
• Experience working with or overseeing external QA partners or freelance reviewers
• ISTQB certification or equivalent QA accreditation
• Knowledge of regional age rating standards, particularly in supported territories

WHY JOIN US?

As an LQA Analyst, you’ll begin your journey at the heart of 2K’s localization efforts—helping ensure our games are clear, culturally relevant, and enjoyable for players around the world. You’ll build foundational skills in linguistic QA within a collaborative, multilingual environment, while gaining hands-on experience with the tools, processes, and workflows that support global game development.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Infosec & TBA Compliance팀은 국내외 모든 비지니스 영역에서 정보처리시스템과 임직원이 정보보호 관련 법적 규제, 보안정책 및 인증 요구사항의 준수 여부를 모니터링하여 평가하고, 식별된 미준수 사항이 신속하게 해결될 수 있도록 지원하는 업무를 수행하고 있습니다.

업무 내용:

• 정보보호 규정준수 모니터링 체계 구축 및 관리

• 정보보호 규정준수 모니터링 계획 수립 및 실행

• 모니터링을 통해 식별된 미준수에 대한 개선 또는 완화 제안

• 정보보호 규정준수 위험을 평가하고 위험 수준에 따라 우선순위 설정

• 정보보호 규정준수 위험 완화 및 개선 지원.

자격 요건:

• 국내/외 정보보호 관련 컴플라이언스 업무 경험 8년 이상.

• 정보통신망법, 통신비밀보호법, 인공지능기본법, 클라우드컴퓨팅법 등에 대한 높은 이해도와 경험이 있으신 분

• IT Infra(Network, Security, Database), 클라우드 환경의 어플리케이션 서비스, 마이크로 서비스 아키텍처에 대한 높은 수준의 기술 경험이 있으신 분.

• 주도적으로 업무를 수행하고, 문제를 해결하고자 하는 열정이 있으신 분.

우대 사항:

• 최신 보안 기술 트렌드 및 관련 법령에 대한 지속적인 학습 의지가 있으신 분.
• 보안 관련 자격증 보유하신 분(CISSP, CISA, CISM, SSCP, CCSP, ISO27001, ISO27017, 정보보안기사, ISMS-P 심사원 등)

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형절차

• 서류전형 – 직무 적합성 인터뷰 – 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격

• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

• 참고사항

• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

jobs.description: Job Description Summary We are seeking a motivated Metrology Technician to join our turbine airfoils machining NPI team at the BladeworX facility. Who We Are

Founded in 2023, Small Axe Studios is 2K’s newest stand-alone studio, built to push the boundaries of game development and bring 2K’s next groundbreaking sports franchise to life. Headquartered in Burnaby, we are assembling a world-class team of visionaries, builders, and passionate gamers who thrive on creative collaboration, technical excellence, and bold ideas. If you’re ready to tackle unique challenges, leave your mark on a brand-new IP, and help shape the future of interactive sports entertainment, we want you on our team!

What We Need

We are looking for a Senior Gameplay Engineer to contribute to the development of new animation features and gameplay mechanics at our new studio. In this role, you will be working closely with Animators, Design and Production to develop nuanced and sophisticated animation behaviors that authentically replicate the beautiful, continuous flow of modern field sports. You will help build the foundation, then iterate and innovate upon it to polish world-class, pitch-perfect gameplay for what will be the next massive sports franchise in our industry.

What You Will Do

•

Collaborate closely with gameplay engineers / designers to identify and develop new gameplay features

•

Feature owner of key animation-driven gameplay mechanics, including complex locomotion, physical duels, and intricate foot-to-object interactions

•

Support requests and features for content creation tools and animation review, helping translate authentic athlete physics, momentum, and sudden changes of direction into interactive systems

•

Assist engineers in making the best use of existing and new animation features

•

Keep up to date with the latest industry work and implement these techniques

•

Write and maintain robust and performant code

•

Optimize code and debug animation issues as they arise

What Will Make You A Great Fit

•

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent work experience)

•

Excellent 3D math and linear algebra skills

•

Solid familiarity and experience with C++

•

3+ years of proven experience working with animation or gameplay systems

•

Implementation experience in one or more of the following areas: inverse kinematics techniques, procedural animation techniques, keyframe animation and forward kinematics

•

Ability to explain technical topics to people of varying levels of expertise

•

An eye for detail in creating dynamic, authentic, and responsive character animation

•

A deep love for video games (not just ours!) and a passion for sports culture, tracking everything from tactical team formations to what happens from the opening whistle to the final second of extra time

Beneficial Qualifications

•

Experience developing and shipping AAA games on Unreal Engine 4 and 5

•

Master’s/PhD in a related field with a focus on animation related topics

•

Familiarity with Python and/or C#

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview:
Building AI agents that can assist with any kind of enterprise work is a challenging, open-ended problem. One key piece of solving it is replicating real work environments as realistically as possible - filling them with hard tasks to solve, creating plausible input data, and defining clear rewards for completing the work the right way. We build many of these reinforcement learning (RL) environments, then drop our agents into them to evaluate or train them.

In this role, you are responsible for creating these RL environments, running AI agents inside them, and improving both the agents and the environments in the process. The results reach customers, whose feedback feeds back in - and the agent/environment improvement loop continues.

Key Responsibilities:
There are many open problems in this space. As a Member of Technical Staff, RL Environments, you will:

- Build new RL environments targeting different agentic capabilities and industry areas

- Train and evaluate agents in those environments

- Make all the pieces work together: tasks, data, tool implementations, and verifiers

- Work across modeling and product to identify gaps in agent performance, and improve both the agents and the environments

- Work with external vendors to create high-quality, expert-built RL environments, and build tools to ensure high task, data, and verifier quality

- Automate the discovery of model capability gaps, and systematically measure agent performance during evals and training

- You have engineered agents and optimized them for specific industry use cases

- You have spent dozens of hours reviewing agent trajectories to pinpoint exact failure points and fix them with model training or harness engineering

- Working proficiency in a modern programming language, familiarity with cloud infrastructure, and working knowledge of DevOps practices

Based in our Helsinki office, onsite, where the majority of the Player Platform team and key stakeholders are located
